messages:
Ana: Kicking off final canary for v2 in us-east now. rolling ~3% traffic to v2 routes. change window 20:00-22:00 UTC. please watch errors/latency and client pin signals.
Devon: copying. whats our trigger to pause/rollback?
Sasha: pause if 1) 5%+ 5xx on any v2 shard for 3 consecutive 5m buckets OR 2) sudden spike in client header pins >0.5% of canary traffic. also abort if rate of schema-mismatch logs >50/min.
Kai: saw an odd header rewrite in the canary logs earlier — sending the sample.
Kai: ```
client_headers:
  - X-Client-Version: 1.4.2
  - X-Forwarded-Proto: https
  - X-Api-Version: v1
```
Marta: Oncall will add a temporary pin for mobile-sdk if we see >=2 independent customers hitting legacy route errors. I have curl to pin ready.
Marta: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://controlplane.redwood.internal/pins 
  -d '{"route":"/generate","version":"v1","reason":"mobile-sdk regressed on v2 canary"}'
```
deploy-bot: Deploy started: v2-canary/us-east · 3% traffic · commit 8f3c2b7 · preflight checks passing. Live at 2026-03-20T20:02:56Z · /deploy/3612349876
Devon: release-notes PR #452 includes the client header negotiation note. make sure SDK teams see it. link: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/452
Ana: Ops: keep an eye on the fallback routing logs — I want to confirm automatic fallback to v1 stays within SLO.
Sasha: added Prom alert: v2_canary_5xx_rate > 5% for 3m. also added log-query for header pins: `count_over_time({route="/generate",client_api_version!="v2"}[5m])`.
Kai: noticed latency P95 up 120ms on long-tail for one shard — looks like kernel fallback for quantized model. engineering looking.
Ana: if we hit either alert, manual pause + pin back to v1 for affected region. I want a short statement for customers if we roll back.
Devon: Draft message for support: "We paused the v2 rollout in US-East due to increased errors for some mobile SDK versions; requests are routing to the stable v1 endpoints while we investigate. We will update with ETA within 60 minutes."
Marta: noted. I'll post that and tag #incidents if we pause.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic scaled to 5% after healthy 15m check.
Sasha: quick sanity: confirm deploybot's health-check uses header negotiation testcases v1/v2 pairs — otherwise we might miss client pins.
Ana: confirmed. health-check suite includes negotiation and schema parity tests.
Kai: engineering found a tiny header-casing bug in the gateway shim, pushing hotfix to canary in 5m.
Devon: if hotfix hits, re-run preflight; if any client pin appears during cooldown, we stop and rollback.
Marta: oncall standing by, will pin route if we see >2 customer errors. ping me @marta on escalation. :thumbsup:
Ana: thanks everyone. will update in this thread with status and final release decision before 22:00 UTC.
